summary: Macon County, GA: the Georgia list ties the Fountain tower to NGS mark CM1651; the 1974 NGS description places the mark at an old lookout tower with footings. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: 1974 NGS description places the station at the site of an old lookout tower and notes its footings; no later source found

access.note: 1974 description says the property was privately owned; no source gives current access

events.note: NGS survey mark set at the site of an old lookout tower; the tower's north footings were noted

notes_for_editor: Tower identity is inferred: the list entry GA367 is named only 'fountain' with no 'lookout tower' in its name, but it is tied to NGS mark CM1651, whose 1974 description calls the site an old lookout tower, and the coordinates match to the fifth decimal. No build date, staffing, fire record or removal date appears in any source. Two WebSearch calls gave no Fountain tower hits. The NGS URL was first tried in a wrong form and failed; the working URL is the one cited. The 1974 description names the landowner; the name is deliberately left out. Elevation: the list gives 461 with no unit; NGS gives an NAVD 88 height of 468 feet. The datums differ and are not reconciled. Research: about four page reads on the NGS datasheet and list.
